title: Organisation intelligence (market/orgs.json)
description: Org-level facts the agent researches: offices in the person's region, teams growing, events, partner programmes, eligibility notes. Every fact has a source.

kind.description: building: what the organisation is building or launching. news: a dated news item (give published_on).

published_on.description: For news: the date it was published.

verified.description: The lead opened the source itself and it says this. Without it, research packs show the line as not yet checked.
